name: Torre di Pisa
description: The Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy, was built in 1173 by the famous architect Nano Pisano. It is located on the right side behind the Romanesque cathedral and is the landmark building of the city of Pisa. Pinku starts from the details, greatly restores the architectural details, and creates a true look and feel from the assembly, allowing famous buildings to be reproduced in the palm of your hand.
